sql: with t as (select distinct o.market_ticker from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Hmmsell10' and o.action='buy'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl, market_exposure, captured_at from positions where market_ticker in (select market_ticker from t) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc, id desc) select case when quantity=0 and realized_pnl is not null then 'settled' else 'open' end st, count(*) n, sum(realized_pnl) realized, sum(case when realized_pnl>0 then 1 else 0 end) wins, sum(abs(market_exposure)) exposure from p group by 1
